title: Accessibility conformance: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum across every route and component
description: The application meets WCAG 2.2 AA: contrast at least 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text and essential non-text UI, a visible focus indicator on every interactive element, pointer target size at least 24x24 CSS pixels, and no keyboard traps anywhere. Conformance applies in both themes and at every declared breakpoint.
rationale: AA is the ratified floor for the blueprint, not a stretch goal. Stating it as a requirement with mechanical ACs is what makes the floor real.
